Joao Pedro capitalized on a precise pass from Cole Palmer to beat Bernd Leno with a magnificent right-footed lob, momentarily silencing the home crowd. However, Fulham refused to be discouraged and began to apply pressure, finding their reward in the 23rd minute. Following a mistake from Robert Sanchez , Joshua King made no mistake, finishing with his right foot to restore parity and ignite the local supporters. The balance remained until shortly before the interval when the Blues accelerated once more. While it seemed the game might be out of reach, Fulham reacted immediately. Just five minutes later, Gonzalo Garcia rose highest to head home, reducing the deficit to 3-2 and reigniting the contest. The final stages of the match were defined by a series of substitutions and rising tension. Timothy Castagne and Calvin Bassey were booked as they struggled to contain counter-attacks. In stoppage time, Fulham launched a desperate offensive, with Rodrigo Muniz and Gonzalo Garcia both seeing late efforts denied by the Chelsea defense and goalkeeper Robert Sanchez . Despite holding 61% of the possession, the hosts could not find a late equalizer, falling to a clinical Chelsea side.

As the clock ticked toward full-time, the City attack, led by late substitutes Rayan Cherki and Antoine Semenyo , forced David Raya and his defenders into action. The Gunners' clinical finishing and defensive resilience earned them the CAF Super Cup trophy in a night to remember.
